name: 守卫
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept character redesign. Image1 is the user's approved unified STYLE AND COMPACT PROPORTION sample. Image2 is the previous identity/theme reference, NOT a costume to trace. Redesign the named subject into a distinctive new Chinese game character design using the direction below. Keep recognizable identity/theme, gender/age, palette and key props but intentionally refresh costume tailoring, silhouette rhythm, hair shape and personality-specific pose. Never clone the female blade sample's red outfit/face/hair across the cast. Match image1's bold controlled contours, coherent large gem-icon handpainted planes, 2-4 simple material shadows, graphic cartoon eyes with one small highlight max, no fragmented triangle mosaic, realistic eyes or 3D gloss. Humans approximately the SAME compact crown-to-sole head/body ratio as image1 (about four heads excluding hair/hats), retaining reasonable lean/stocky identity differences, no long-legged six-head fashion proportions. All women clearly adult, attractive natural full feminine curves and tailored garments but agile rather than heavy/barrel-thick; men retain distinct age/physique. Faces and bodies three-quarter facing SCREEN LEFT. Mild dynamic weight shift, two anatomically coherent separate legs and both feet readable, no parallel stiff pose or hidden extra leg. Props and hands structurally correct. Entire single full-body subject and ALL props safely inside a square canvas with 8% margins. Plain warm ivory #F4EFDF background, no shadows/scene/text/panels/extra people. Strong broad shape contrast, detail concentrated in only one or two zones. SPECIFIC DESIGN: 守卫：成年壮实男性，方下颌、短黑下巴胡须、短髻，稳重可靠。重设计赭黄无袖厚布护衣与靛灰交领，胸口一块完整梯形布面、低宽腰封，深棕宽束腿裤、绑腿与厚布靴。图形主题方形、矩形、稳定水平线，轮廓厚重但非胖。左前持单根直木长矛，右臂圆木盾仅一个铁盾脐；矛杆连续、圆盾不变方盾。盾与身体错开保持辨识，双脚前后略错稳定护卫姿势。不加欧美板甲。
